name: Kovan Giryon

abilities.name: Sword Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Mind Blast
abilities.description: Kovan Giryon casts a spell that assaults your mind, dealing high magical damage. This attack must be dodged at the right time.

abilities.name: Mind Manipulation
abilities.description: Kovan Giryon casts a spell that inflicts torment upon your mind for a duration, indicated by a circular AoE that tracks your movement, dealing moderate continuous magical damage that cannot be avoided.

abilities.name: Dash
abilities.description: Kovan Giryon dashes to the outer edge of the arena, hitting those in his way for high magical damage, indicated by a circular AoE around him. He uses this before and after Chaotic Ray.

abilities.name: Chaotic Ray
abilities.description: Kovan Giryon casts a spell for a brief moment, releasing a long beam of yellow energy that courses across the arena, indicated by a long rectangular AoE, dealing very high magical damage. The beam lingers for an extended duration. After the first summoning phase, Kovan Giryon's clones in the room will assist him in this abilities, casting rays of their own, making the arena harder to traverse.

abilities.name: Magical Slam
abilities.description: Kovan Giryon teleports to the center of the arena and slams into the ground, causing a magical explosion, indicated by a large growing circular AoE, dealing very high magical damage. Following the first summon phase, a clone of Kovan Giryon that floats in the center of the arena will take over for him in using this ability, freeing Kovan Giryon to do other things.

abilities.name: Converge
abilities.description: Occasionally, Kovan Giryon will cause one of his clones resting dormant in the room to come rushing towards him, hitting anyone in its path, ad indicated by a circular AoE, dealing high magical damage. An explosion occurs when the clone reaches Kovan Giryon, which also deals high magical damage.

abilities.name: Summons from the Past
abilities.description: At 70%, Kovan Giryon floats into the air in the center of the arena and becomes invulnerable to damage. The screen becomes darker and creatures from the past are summoned into the arena. These include Primitive Nix-Ox as the most dangerous opponent, accompanied by Primitive Kwama and Primitive Nix-Hounds. The creatures must all be slain to make Kovan Giryon come down and become vulnerable to damage again. At 45% health, the enemies are comprised of an Iron Atronach, accompanied by Fire Shalks and Flame Salamanders. At 20%, all of the enemies in both enemy pools appear together.
